notes: One entry per (adapter, width, batch, parameter-storage policy) the LN1/low-rank forward route was measured at. `route` is the graph that won there: `staged` is the separate layer norm plus the interpolation, the three first-stage matmuls and the second-stage matmuls on their own dispatches; `fused` is the single LN1/low-rank producer that keeps one row's w/a/g rank activations resident through the layer norm, the activation, the second-stage matmuls, decay and the final gate. `candidates` holds the measured median milliseconds of every candidate, and the loader refuses an entry whose route is not the fastest candidate it lists. An entry with no `parameter_storage` is the default verdict every storage policy falls back to; an entry carrying `parameter_storage` was measured under that execution-storage policy and applies only to a consumer running it. The `fp16-storage-*` training policies differ in compute, not storage, so they share one `fp16-storage` verdict, and the op-level `fp16-packed-mirror` label canonicalizes into it. The two policies crossover differently -- the deep FP16 producer takes the chain from batch 8 while the FP32 producer keeps the fusion there -- so the dimension is what lets the FP16 route take its own measured wins without moving the FP32 route. Each entry's `measured_by` names the driver that produced it. The runtime reads this table with the op's own policy, so a device with no entry keeps the structural default. Re-record a policy's own entries with that driver's `--record-decisions`. The `fp16-storage` entries were recorded with a 1% band rather than the dense route's 2%: that route's staged win at batch 16 measures 1.4-3.5% in every sweep and has never flipped sign, so a 2% band would discard a stable verdict. The band gates recording only; lookups read whatever entry exists. A `withheld` entry records a route that was measured and won but may not be adopted: the FP16-storage low-rank A/B is not bit-identical (2.384e-07 worst), the training trajectory is bit-exact, and the runtime therefore keeps the structural fused graph at those geometries.

withheld.reason: The fused and staged graphs differ under fp16-storage parameter values (worst |diff| above zero in this driver's parity comparison), while the training trajectory is held bit-exact. The measured win stays in the record as evidence, but the runtime does not adopt it and keeps the structural fused graph.
